# Mobashir Ali — AI Receptionist & Web Systems Engineering

## Core Services
1. **AI Receptionist for Dental Clinics & Local Businesses:**
   - 24/7 autonomous call answering, patient triage, automated appointment scheduling into PMS/calendars, insurance inquiry handling, and SMS follow-ups.
2. **Custom Web Application Engineering:**
   - High-performance, SEO-optimized web systems built with React, Vite, Next.js, and Astro.
3. **Desktop Automation & OCR Utilities:**
   - Real-time directory monitoring, document categorization, PDF/Image OCR extraction, and local database indexing.

## Key Projects & Case Studies
- **RentDivider (https://rentdivider.com):** Algorithmic fair rent splitting SaaS based on room dimensions, amenities, and private facilities.
- **Smart Automated File Organizer (https://github.com/mobashirali0316-star/smart-file-organizer):** Cross-platform Python desktop application with real-time watchdog monitoring, PyMuPDF text parsing, Tesseract OCR, and SQLite search indexing.
- **Revive Dental Clinic (https://revive-dental-hazel.vercel.app/):** Aesthetic dentistry and facial cosmetic clinic portal with patient intake workflows and smile design gallery.
- **VK Dental Care (https://vk-dental-blue.vercel.app/):** Dental surgery practice web portal with treatment showcase and appointment conversion funnel.
- **Kubek Family Dentistry (https://kubek-denral-care.vercel.app/):** Cosmetic and family dentistry portal optimized for local search discovery and patient intake.
- **Presento (https://presentov2.vercel.app/):** Student attendance and presence analytics system with real-time reporting.
- **Campus360 AI (https://campus360-ai.vercel.app):** Resource scheduling and classroom capacity optimizer.
